question: 2016年一共有多少笔已送达订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2016-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-01-01';

question: 订单金额总和最高的前5个州是哪些？
gold_sql: SELECT c.customer_state, ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 5;

question: 已送达订单平均每单收到几条客户评价？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(c), 2) AS avg_reviews FROM (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders o JOIN order_reviews r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY o.order_id);

question: 2015年有多少笔订单？
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2015-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2016-01-01';

question: 在所有支付记录中，boleto银行付款单的平均每笔支付金额是多少？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(payment_value), 2) AS avg_value FROM order_payments WHERE payment_type='boleto';

question: 2017年哪个月的订单量最高？
gold_sql: SELECT substr(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 7) AS ym, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM orders WHERE order_status='delivered' AND order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01' GROUP BY ym ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1;

question: 已送达订单中，health_beauty美妆健康品类的总销售额是多少（含运费）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_category_translation pct ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND pct.product_category_name_english = 'health_beauty';

question: 已取消(canceled)的订单总共涉及多少金额？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS total FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='canceled';

question: 里约州(RJ)已送达订单的平均客单价是多少（客单价=单笔订单的order_items商品金额含运费合计，取全部订单的均值）？
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' AND c.customer_state='RJ';

question: 已送达订单中，平均商品单价最高的前3个卖家是谁？
gold_sql: SELECT oi.seller_id, ROUND(AVG(oi.price), 2) AS avg_price FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status='delivered' GROUP BY oi.seller_id ORDER BY avg_price DESC LIMIT 3;
